Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer repeatedly performed similar queries to retrieve George Gershwin’s place of death without adapting search strategies or leveraging authoritative sources effectively to resolve the conflicting information (Hollywood, California vs. Hastings-on-Hudson, New York). The agent failed to prioritize the New York Times obituary, which clearly confirmed the death location as Hollywood, California, and instead persisted in redundant attempts without producing new actionable data. This prolonged the resolution and left the task in an inefficient verification loop with diminishing returns.
